name: Pack
description:
When you use Call Animals, when the spell ends, you may choose to form a permanent, lifelong bond with the summoned animals. They become your pack, accompanying you on your adventures. In addition to the behaviors described in Call Animals, the creatures will defend you and any of your allies that have shown them kindness.

Your bond does not impart special intelligence or understanding to the creatures. Your communication with them is limited to simple commands and emotions.

If one of the creatures dies, check a Condition.
